summary: Invest in your workforce with our Soft Skills Development Training. Equip employees with essential interpersonal skills for better teamwork and productivity.
lede: Soft skills training helps professionals at every level communicate, collaborate, and respond constructively to workplace challenges. Through role-play, reflection, and practical exercises, participants develop emotional awareness, practise active listening and feedback, strengthen empathy and teamwork, and use constructive approaches to conflict resolution and workplace change.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals at all levels who are seeking to strengthen their interpersonal, communication, and leadership abilities.
modules: Understanding Soft Skills and Emotional Intelligence
Empathy, Diversity, and Inclusion at Work
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of workplace dynamics and be currently employed or have prior work experience. No specific educational background is required.
